data.camera: cowboy shot, standing before the royal throne as the golden crown is presented
data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 女王加冕】大教堂的加冕礼上，希斯特里亚接过王冠的瞬间抬起头，白色礼服与金色长发在大教堂的光柱中熠熠生辉，她深吸一口气——「从今天起，我不再是任何人手中的棋子。」
data.promptProse: Historia stands before the royal throne in her white coronation gown and ceremonial cloak, lifting her face as the golden crown is presented toward her. The cowboy view preserves the hands offering the crown and the altar-side space around her. Cathedral light shafts illuminate her blonde hair and gold jewelry, while the throne carvings behind remain shaded and the white fabric receives reflected brightness from the pale stone floor.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 女王加冕
